newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Aukland details rights offer price.
newsitem.headline: Aukland details rights offer price.

text.p: South African healthcare firm Aukland Investments Ltd said ordinary shareholders would be able to subscribe to its previously announced rights issue at a subscription price of 400 cents per new share.

The issue, intended to raise 71.6 million rand, would be in the ratio of 65 shares for every 100 ordinary shares held, and a total of 17.9 million news shares would be issued with effect from the start of trading on August 7, 1997.
The offer is intended to facilitate the investment of the Pamodzi Consortium.
The last day to register for the rights offer would be July 11, 1997.
